data.text: Of David. When he feigned madness before Abimelech, so that he drove him away and he departed. א  Aleph I will bless Yahweh at all times; His praise shall continually be in my mouth.
ב  Beth My soul will make its boast in Yahweh; The humble will hear it and rejoice.
ג  Gimel O magnify Yahweh with me, And let us exalt His name together.
ד  Daleth I inquired of Yahweh, and He answered me, And delivered me from all that I dread. ה  He - ו Vav
They looked to Him and were radiant, And their faces will never be humiliated.
ז  Zayin This poor man called out, and Yahweh heard him And saved him out of all his troubles.
ח  Heth The angel of Yahweh encamps around those who fear Him, And rescues them.
ט  Teth O taste and see that Yahweh is good; How blessed is the man who takes refuge in Him!
י  Yodh Oh, fear Yahweh, you His saints; For there is no want to those who fear Him.
כ  Kaph The young lions do lack and suffer hunger; But they who inquire of Yahweh shall not be in want of any good thing.
ל  Lamedh Come, you children, listen to me; I will teach you the fear of Yahweh.
מ  Mem Who is the man who delights in life And loves many days that he may see good?
נ  Nun Guard your tongue from evil And your lips from speaking deceit.
ס  Samekh Depart from evil and do good; Seek peace and pursue it.
ע  Ayin The eyes of Yahweh are toward the righteous And His ears are open to their cry for help.
פ  Pe The face of Yahweh is against evildoers, To cut off the memory of them from the earth.
צ  Tsadhe The righteous cry, and Yahweh hears And delivers them out of all their troubles.
ק  Qoph Yahweh is near to the brokenhearted And saves those who are crushed in spirit.
ר  Resh Many are the evils against the righteous, But Yahweh delivers him out of them all.
שׁ  Shin He keeps all his bones, Not one of them is broken.
ת  Tav Evil shall slay the wicked, And those who hate the righteous will be condemned.
Yahweh redeems the soul of His slaves, And all those who take refuge in Him will not be condemned.
